project_goal: Enable robust 3D understanding for an LLM while reducing dependence on large-scale 3D paired data.
paper_method_goal: Show that the model can use large-scale text-based alignment first, then use limited 3D data to connect point-cloud representations to the language model.

innovations.what: A compact local-to-global aggregation path is used before point features are conditioned into the LLM.
caveats: Treat parameter-free wording as a hypothesis until all involved operators are checked for learnable parameters.

innovations.what: Core novelty emphasis is stage design and modality-transfer strategy rather than replacing the base LLM backbone.
caveats: Final trainable subset per stage must be cross-checked with actual launch scripts/arguments.

design_intents.intent: Use large text supervision to reduce dependence on scarce point-text pairs.
design_intents.rationale: The method narrative should explain why text-first alignment lowers 3D data pressure.
caveats: Stage behavior in code is controlled by flags (stage_2, tune_mm_mlp_adapter, fix_llm/fix_pointnet), not explicit Stage-I/II/III classes.
Release scripts should be verified as real content (not LFS pointer) before claiming exact command-level differences.

design_intents.intent: Keep one projector interface across stages to stabilize transfer from text-side alignment to point-side alignment.
design_intents.rationale: A shared bridge simplifies modality transfer logic and keeps the method storyline coherent.

design_intents.intent: Compress point-token sequences before LLM fusion to keep useful structure with manageable token cost.
design_intents.rationale: Supports the efficiency-plus-information-retention argument without overloading the language model context.
caveats: Phrase as code-aligned aggregation/routing unless parameter counts are explicitly audited at symbol level.
